annotations.title: Add Business Days to a Date

description: Business days / working days calculator: add N business days to a date for one country, skipping weekends and public holidays, bank closures, or both (calendar: business, bank, combined). Returns the resulting date and the skipped dates with reasons.

calendar.description: business (default) skips national public holidays. bank skips bank closures: US Federal Reserve holidays, Danmarks Nationalbank closing days (DK), UK bank holidays (GB, or one nation GB-ENG, GB-WLS, GB-SCT, GB-NIR), and TARGET2 euro closing days. combined skips both. Other countries have no bank data, so bank and combined return an error for them.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code or English country name. UK is accepted for the United Kingdom. In bank mode also GB-ENG, GB-WLS, GB-SCT, GB-NIR, or TARGET2.

days.description: Whole number of business days to add. Negative walks backward. 0 returns the start date.

name: add_business_days

alternatives.description: Other cities that matched the same name, after the best-ranked city was chosen. The order is the site search order: match, then priority, then population.

title: Add business days to a date
